name: get_profile_summary
description: The user's fictional investor profile, current weights, caps and the assumptions behind them.

context_key.description: Session key given in the user message. Pass it unchanged.

name: get_profile_features
description: How the app reads the profile: risk capacity, horizon class, loss and stress tolerances, needs (income, quality, ESG), speculation aversion and the component weights of the fit score with the reason for each adjustment.

context_key.description: Session key given in the user message. Pass it unchanged.

name: get_asset_features
description: Computed features per asset (CAD base): returns 1M-3Y, volatility, drawdowns, Sharpe/Sortino, beta, RSI, moving averages, MACD, ATR, liquidity, market cap, dividends, fundamentals (SEC XBRL), factor exposures, GARCH forecast, regime probability, news and insider features, with definitions and reasons for missing values.

context_key.description: Session key given in the user message. Pass it unchanged.

groups.description: Comma-separated groups: returns, risk, tail, risk_adjusted, relative, technical, liquidity, size_income, fundamentals, factors, forecast, regime, news, insider, earnings (default: the main ones)

name: get_news
description: Dated filings (SEC EDGAR), central-bank releases, policy-rate decisions and headlines from allow-listed outlets, with publisher, link, event type, materiality and sentiment. Use it to explain answers with sources.

context_key.description: Session key given in the user message. Pass it unchanged.

tickers.description: Comma-separated tickers; omit for market-wide items

days.description: Look-back in days from the end date (default 30)

end.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD (default: data as-of date)

name: explain_price_move
description: Unusual daily moves of one asset (3+ standard deviations) with the filings, articles and policy decisions published around each date. Use for 'why did X fall/rise'.

context_key.description: Session key given in the user message. Pass it unchanged.

name: get_market_regime
description: Current market regime (stress, correction, volatile, calm uptrend, mixed) from SPY and XIU.TO trend, drawdown and regime probability, plus policy rates and yield curves, with the rules used.

context_key.description: Session key given in the user message. Pass it unchanged.

name: get_asset_metrics
description: Historical risk/return metrics (CAD base) for assets, with the data period and provenance. Use for any number you state about an asset.

context_key.description: Session key given in the user message. Pass it unchanged.

window.description: Metrics window such as '3y' or '5y'. Omit for the default.

name: score_assets
description: Profile-fit ranking (0-100) of the asset universe, best first, with verdict, status (ok, caution, cap_reached, over_cap, excluded), rank stability under perturbed weights, top driver and main drag.

context_key.description: Session key given in the user message. Pass it unchanged.

include_excluded.description: Include assets excluded by the user's preferences

window.description: Metrics window such as '3y' or '5y'. Omit for the default.

name: explain_asset_fit
description: Breakdown of one asset's fit score: each component's score, weight, explanation and evidence, gates and drivers.

context_key.description: Session key given in the user message. Pass it unchanged.

window.description: Metrics window such as '3y' or '5y'. Omit for the default.

name: check_constraints
description: Governance check of a proposed fictional position against the user's caps, ESG screens, risk limits and horizon. Returns status (aligned, review, conflict), flags, before/after statistics and alternatives. Call it for ANY request to add or increase a position.

context_key.description: Session key given in the user message. Pass it unchanged.

weight.description: Share of the portfolio as a decimal, 0.3 = 30%

window.description: Metrics window such as '3y' or '5y'. Omit for the default.

name: get_portfolio_radar
description: Nine-axis portfolio profile (diversification, risk, geography, USD exposure, defensiveness, growth, ESG, income, event exposure) vs the target for the profile.

context_key.description: Session key given in the user message. Pass it unchanged.

window.description: Metrics window such as '3y' or '5y'. Omit for the default.

name: get_suggestions
description: Rule-based suggestions from portfolio gaps and constraint flags, with candidate assets and what-if impacts, plus top picks.

context_key.description: Session key given in the user message. Pass it unchanged.

window.description: Metrics window such as '3y' or '5y'. Omit for the default.

name: run_stress
description: Replay a historical scenario on the user's fictional portfolio; reports coverage and holdings without data.

context_key.description: Session key given in the user message. Pass it unchanged.

window.description: Metrics window such as '3y' or '5y'. Omit for the default.

name: get_signals
description: Recent enriched signals (world events, official statements, filings, posts) touching tickers, with source URLs, severity and sentiment.

context_key.description: Session key given in the user message. Pass it unchanged.
